python3 /home/ankit114/repos/paid_ads_mybcat/scripts/secret_exec.py --secret-env BLAND_API_KEY=mybcat/ai/api-keys/bland -- python3 - <<'PY' > discovery.txt 2>&1
import json, os, re, urllib.error, urllib.request
raw = os.environ["BLAND_API_KEY"].strip()
key = raw
if raw.startswith("{"):
    try:
        p = json.loads(raw)
        key = next((p[k] for k in ("api_key", "key", "value") if p.get(k)), raw)
    except Exception:
        pass
pid = "94abad8b-fbe2-4e67-9c64-d9b586dd2653"
for name, url in (("pathway", "https://api.bland.ai/v1/pathway/%s" % pid), ("versions", "https://api.bland.ai/v1/pathway/%s/versions" % pid)):
    try:
        req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={"authorization": key, "User-Agent": "mybcat-cli"})
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=60) as r:
            body = r.read().decode()
            code = r.status
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        body = e.read().decode(errors="replace")[:300]
        code = e.code
    except Exception as e:
        body = type(e).__name__
        code = 0
    open(name + ".json", "w").write(body)
    print("GET_%s_HTTP=%s" % (name.upper(), code))
    hits = sorted(set(re.findall(r'"[^"]*(?:[Mm]odel|llm|LLM|engine)[^"]*"\s*:\s*[^,}]{0,80}', body)))
    print("SCAN %s.json:" % name)
    for h in hits[:40]:
        print("  " + h)
    if not hits:
        print("  NONE-FOUND")
print("SCAN_DONE")
PY
rc=$?; tail -25 discovery.txt; exit $rc
